message.content: 抱歉，我目前沒有可用的工具來搜尋「邁阿密的寵物友好火車站」資訊。若您需要這類資訊，建議直接查詢 Amtrak 或當地交通部門的官方網站，或使用地圖服務（如 Google Maps）搜尋「pet-friendly train station Miami」以獲得最新的政策與可用性。若您還有其他旅遊相關需求（例如酒店、餐廳、景點等），請隨時告訴我，我很樂意協助！

The tool find_hotel is for hotels, not train stations. There's no function for train stations. So we cannot use the function. We need to respond that we can't find train stations. We can provide general info: maybe mention Amtrak stations, but not sure about pet policy. We can say we don't have data. We can ask clarifying question.
